name: Mam ruoi
summary: Mắm rươi is the salt cure on the same city introduction. Cleaned rươi is tossed with salt, kept about 10 days, sun-dried, mixed with tangerine peel, and sealed in a jar. It is a dip for rau sống, and the page says boiled pork in particular.
origin: Vinh. The city introduction sets it beside chả rươi and calls the cure simpler.
howToEat: Use it as a dip. The city introduction does not print a salt ratio. The cure it does print is about 10 days, then sun, then tangerine peel. A season month was not printed. Check on arrival. A price is Check on arrival.
where: A street was not printed. Check on arrival.
